name: Novelda (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Novelda (quartered with the Senyera, birds, a crescent and a chequy field, supported by dragons).
history: Municipal flag of Novelda; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Novelda arms — quartered, supported by dragons
